title: MicroGrow Sensor Comparison
objective: Compare candidate temperature and humidity sensors for MicroGrow V1/V0.1 PCB direction.
hypothesis: SHTC3/SHT-series sensors will be more stable and production-suitable than low-cost DHT22 modules.
test_plan: Mount each sensor in the same airflow, log 30 minutes of readings, then compare stability, noise and wiring complexity.
setup_notes: ESP32 bench rig, short wiring runs, same sampling interval, indoor ambient conditions.
results: Template sample only. Results still pending final bench capture.
lesson_learned: Always keep sensor comparisons on the same test rig so the data stays comparable.
